cases.datasetAuthorExpectation: Uncapped Indebtedness permission unlocked only if FCCR > 2.0x and Payment Conditions are satisfied; enumerated exceptions follow separately.
Aggregate principal amount outstanding at any time not to exceed the greater of $70,000,000 and 5.5% of total consolidated assets per GAAP balance sheet.
General Lien prohibition subject only to Permitted Liens (including replacement liens for refinanced §6.01(d) debt on the same assets).
General Restricted Payment prohibition with enumerated exceptions; some exceptions gated by Payment Conditions.
Payment Conditions = no Default + Specified Availability ≥ greater of 20% Revolving Commitment and $13,000,000 (pro forma, 30-day lookback) + delivery of certificate.
General Indebtedness prohibition on Borrower/Restricted Subsidiaries subject to lettered exceptions.
Guaranties of supplier/customer/franchisee/licensee obligations in the ordinary course, capped at the greater of $2,500,000 and 5% of Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA.
Restricted Payments up to the greater of $21,000,000 and 35% of Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA, conditioned on no continuing Event of Default.
Unlimited Restricted Payments so long as Total Rent Adjusted Net Leverage Ratio, calculated Pro Forma, would not exceed 3.50:1.00.
Cumulative Available Amount builder: CNI Growth Amount (ratio-gated) + Qualified Capital Stock proceeds Not Otherwise Applied + other builder components; deep nesting.
CONMED §7.2 Limitation on Indebtedness — general prohibition with lettered exceptions.
General Investments/loans/advances limitation with enumerated exceptions.

Intercreditor joinder / priority mechanics are not a negative-covenant basket representation in the current IR target set.
